mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, the weather at the Verona Public Library is a clear 48 degrees with an air quality index of 51.

Construction is coming to Hwy M near the new Aldi site starting October 5, requiring a full closure through October 7 for road improvements. Also, please be aware of a scam involving fake emails asking for payment of city planning fees; the city never accepts payments via wire transfer or online credit card.

We have a busy schedule! The Dane County Farmer's Market is today at the State Capitol. Looking ahead, yoga is available at Insight Wellness on September 28, and you can test your knowledge at Hop Haus Trivia this coming September 29.
Regarding the weekly report, on September 5, police encountered a social media trend where vehicles were found covered in cheese slices across several streets, including North and South Main.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Oreo Reese's Cheesecake, and you can stop by when the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
